ROUND 2b (pre-review audit of round 2)
--------------------------------------
  CA2000 exclusion narrowed from T:Godot.GodotObject to T:Godot.Node (CA2213: Node|Resource): the measured extra sites
    were 2 (fix/CA2000-node-exclusion-extra-sites.txt): PartDefinition's exported PackedScene (cache-owned) and a test
    InputEvent (now disposed). dispose_ownership_transfer_at_constructor removed (it contradicted Borrowed); the 3 test
    sites it covered are fixed (harness owns its objects; the reset test owns the device and lends it).
  Device gate: a queued waiter is handed the count on release, so CurrentCount == 1 means idle. The round-2 commit's
    "dispose on any release after disposal" disposed the gate under a queued waiter: fix/M2 shows the new test failing
    on that logic (SemaphoreSlim ObjectDisposedException instead of the device's) and passing on the fix.
  New native tests: borrowed warm-up then owned initialise on one device; gate disposal with a queued waiter, while
    free and while a candidate holds it; installation cause logged versus supersession silent; fixed-binary decoder
    fuzz (commands and responses); guard: `catch { ; }` is empty, and every hook/CI protection fragment is present.
  dotnet test CuriousContraptions.slnx: CuriousContraptions.tests 1016/1016 (PLAYTEST 1030/1030); Coverage.Tests 65/68
    (pre-existing).
  CI reproduced exactly as pages.yml is written, on a fresh physical checkout-index snapshot: restore, both slnx
    builds, web compile, both anvil apps, dotnet test, publish and bundle checks -> exit 0 in 113 s
    (fix/CI-fresh-snapshot.log). The first attempt, before the guard's pin update, also passed restore and every build.
  Hook wall time on this machine: 36 s (snapshot, restore, 3 from-scratch builds, 2 apps, 38 guard tests, anvil).
  Stream evidence: no recorded run in either checkout contains "WarmupSimulation non-fatal", "FAULT 1:" or
    "CCGPU_ADVANCE_EXCEPTION" (searched _bmad-output, docs, main .anvil), so the move to stderr is a Chrome check.
